description: AI timeline extraction — Turns any narrative, news story, case history, incident notes or email thread into a clean chronological timeline: ISO dates (relative dates resolved against ref_date=), times, one-line events, actors, certainty (exact/approximate/relative) and a supporting quote, then sorted and validated offline with days between events, total span, longest gap and actor counts. text= up to 20,000 characters. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description: e.g. On March 5 2024 Acme signed the merger agreement with Beta Corp. Two weeks later regulators opened a review, and the deal closed on September 30 2024.

name: ai_timeline
